input.summary: Limit the Company's exclusivity in Section 6.1 to 12 months and add an automatic performance-based exit.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 6.1 locks us out of any similar Deerskin internet project for the whole term, which auto-renews annually and can only be exited on 90 days' notice with a Termination Payment, and there is no release if HDI underperforms. Our playbook does not accept exclusivity on the customer for the full term without a performance exit, so we have capped the restriction at twelve months and made it fall away automatically if HDI misses a delivery date or service level. HDI's reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 is unchanged.

ops.oldText: during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate
ops.newText: during the period of twelve (12) months following the Effective Date, the Company shall not participate

ops.oldText: directly to the consumer on the Internet.
ops.newText: directly to the consumer on the Internet. The restrictions on the Company set forth in this Section 6.1 shall terminate automatically, without further notice, penalty or liability, upon any failure by HDI to meet any delivery date or service or performance level required under this Agreement (including, without limitation, Section 1.6).
